coastal.title: Alberta man charged with arson for 2020 fire at Burnaby Hospital
coastal.description: An Alberta man has been arrested and charged with arson in connection to a fire at Burnaby Hospital in 2020 that health officials said contributed to a deadly COVID-19 outbreak.

coastal.title: After years of family doctor shortages, the North Shore has room for 20,000 new patients
coastal.description: So many residents of the North Shore now have family doctors, physicians are now actively recruiting patients. How did the region turn the tide of the family doctor shortage?

prince-george.title: B.C. foregoes bar exam in favour of new program for law students
prince-george.description: British Columbia is the sixth province to scrap the bar exam.

prince-george.title: B.C. expediting forestry reviews in Fort St. John, Fort Nelson after 'catastrophic' wildfire losses
prince-george.description: The B.C. government is expediting reviews of timber harvests in Fort St. John and Fort Nelson after years of “catastrophic wildfires” and new Indigenous land designations and wildlife protections.
